title: Syria Golan detentions fuel fury at Israeli forces, doubts in new government
gist: Amberin Zaman reports from Quneitra that Israeli forces have detained more than 240 Syrians since Assad's fall in December 2024 (over 40 still unaccounted for) and continue drone/artillery strikes and incursions near the Golan buffer zone, paralyzing the agricultural economy and breeding both fury at Israel and disillusionment with Ahmed al-Sharaa's government for failing to protect residents.

insights.claim: Rights monitors say Israeli security forces have detained more than 240 Syrians since the fall of Bashar al-Assad's regime in December 2024, transferring an unconfirmed number to Israel in what rights groups call illegal renditions; at least 200 had been freed by August 2026 but over 40 remain unaccounted for.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Ongoing detentions are a persistent friction point that complicates any Israel-Syria security arrangement.
insights.quote: Israeli security forces have detained more than 240 Syrians
insights.locator: Figures vary, but rights monitors say

insights.claim: A 17-year-old Quneitra resident, Ibrahim, described being seized in a 3 a.m. raid, questioned about non-existent links to Islamic State and Hezbollah, and held incommunicado for 13 months with what he described as physical and psychological torture in Israeli prisons.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Illustrates how Israel's counterterror framing in southern Syria is generating local hostility that could feed future militancy.
insights.quote: So began 13 months of incommunicado detention

themes.theme: Local economic and social damage in Quneitra

insights.claim: Continued Israeli drone and artillery strikes in Quneitra have terrorized communities and paralyzed an economy that depends heavily on agriculture.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Southern Syria's recovery is stalled by insecurity, undermining the economic base needed for post-Assad stabilization.
insights.quote: paralyzed an economy that depends heavily on agriculture
insights.locator: Such feelings of impotence and abandonment

insights.claim: Israeli military operations mainly affect Sunni Arab communities on the fringes of the buffer zone monitored by UNDOF since 1974.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Concentration on Sunni Arab communities — the new government's core constituency — raises domestic political cost for Damascus.
insights.locator: They are among the victims of sustained

themes.theme: Erosion of trust in the new Syrian government

insights.claim: Feelings of impotence and abandonment are pervasive across Quneitra, with residents disillusioned with their own government for failing to protect them from Israeli operations.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Perceived weakness against Israel is a legitimacy risk for al-Sharaa's interim government, potentially constraining its room for normalization or security deals with Israel.
insights.quote: Such feelings of impotence and abandonment are pervasive across Quneitra
insights.locator: Such feelings of impotence and abandonment

insights.claim: Israeli forces pushed into the Golan buffer zone and seized strategic Mount Hermon as opposition forces led by Ahmed al-Sharaa toppled Assad.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Israel's expanded territorial footprint in Syria is entrenched and remains a core dispute in any bilateral arrangement.
insights.quote: Israeli forces pushed into the buffer zone, seizing the strategic Mount Hermon
insights.locator: Israeli forces pushed into the buffer zone

insights.claim: Within 48 hours of Assad's fall, Israeli jets and naval vessels destroyed as much as 80% of Syria's military assets, including air defenses, missile depots, aircraft and tanks, according to an Israeli military assessment.
insights.speaker: Amberin Zaman
insights.so_what: Syria's near-total military disarmament leaves Damascus unable to resist incursions, explaining its residents' sense of abandonment and its reliance on diplomacy.
insights.quote: destroyed as much as 80% of Syria's military assets
insights.locator: Israeli forces pushed into the buffer zone
